info.title: otel-ducklake query API
info.description: Query traces, logs and metrics stored in DuckLake by otel-ducklake.

parameters.name: to

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Relative window ending at `to`, e.g. `15m`, `1h`, `7d`. Ignored when `from` is set.

ApiError.description: Error body returned with every non-2xx response.

AttributeCount.description:
One attribute key, or one value of the key asked for. Keys of span, log or
point attributes and of resource attributes are counted together, as the
`attributes` filters match both.

count.description: Sampled rows with this key (or value).

value.description: The value, when a `key` was asked for.

AttributeStats.description: Attribute keys (or values of one key) with how many sampled rows have them.

sampled_rows.description: Rows counted: a random sample of at most 10,000 of the matching rows.

Capabilities.description: Server settings a client needs to know before it queries or sends data.

flush_interval_secs.description:
Buffered data is written at least this often (`ingest.flush_interval`),
so new data can take this long to show up in queries.

ingest_auth.description: OTLP ingest needs a bearer token (`auth.ingest_tokens` is set).

retention_secs.description: How long data is kept, in seconds (0 = forever).

buffered_bytes.description: Approximate bytes waiting in memory for the next flush.

buffered_rows.description: Rows waiting in memory for the next flush.

dropped_rows.description:
Rows dropped because their table refused them with a permanent
error, e.g. a column changed by hand (details in the server log).

max_buffer_bytes.description: Requests are rejected (HTTP 429 / gRPC UNAVAILABLE) above this.

signals.description: Per signal counters since process start.

LogSeriesPoint.description: Log counts per bucket, split by severity band.

RedStats.description: Rate, errors and duration for a service or operation.

rate_per_sec.description: Spans per second over the window.

time_column.description: Time column the table is partitioned and pruned by; filter on it.

accepted.description: Spans, log records or metric data points accepted.

invalid.description:
Items refused for good: invalid (e.g. a span without a valid trace
or span id, reported as OTLP partial success) or in a request too
large for the buffer.

throttled.description:
Items refused because the write buffer was full (HTTP 429 / gRPC
UNAVAILABLE). Exporters retry them, so they usually arrive later.

throttled_requests.description:
Requests refused with back-pressure (HTTP 429 / gRPC UNAVAILABLE):
by the in-flight memory limit before the body is read (their items
are unknown, so not in `throttled`), or by the full write buffer.
Exporters retry them.

query.description:
One read-only `SELECT`/`WITH` statement. Tables live in schema `lake.otel`
(the default search path, so `FROM spans` works).

rows.description: Row values as JSON. Non-JSON types (timestamps, UUIDs, maps) are rendered as strings.

truncated.description:
True when more rows existed than `limit`, or the rows reached the
server's size cap (32 MiB of row data).

oneOf.description: What this server allows and keeps. Missing from older servers.

inlined_rows.description: Rows currently inlined in the catalog database, waiting to be flushed to Parquet.

rows.description: Rows in live Parquet files (excludes rows still inlined in the catalog).

Temporality.description:
Aggregation temporality of sums and histograms; empty for gauges and
summaries. `mixed`: the metric catalog's value for a metric with both
delta and cumulative points.

root_service.description: Service of the root span, if the root span was received.
